import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int p, k, t;
    static boolean[] used;

    static void dfs(int x) {
        used[x] = true;
        int to = (int) (((long) x * k) % p);
        if (!used[to]) {
            dfs(to);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        p = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        used = new boolean[p];
        t = 0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (!used[i]) {
                t++;
                dfs(i);
            }
        }
        
        long ans = 1;
        int exponent = t + (k == 1 ? 1 : 0);
        int MOD = 1000000007;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < exponent; i++) {
            ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
        }
        
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
